result.summary: The page appears visually intact overall, but the promotional banner has a significant text-contrast problem.

issues.description: The white headline and offer details on the pale mint promotional banner have very low contrast, making the promotion code and minimum-order requirement difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark green text or darken the banner background. Ensure contrast reaches at least 4.5:1 for regular text and 3:1 for large text.
